# Router

## Definition

The entry point for deciding which domain models a subject. It routes *meaning*;
`LIBRARY_MAP.md` routes *physical placement*, and the two are independent by design — a numbered
class may host a domain, and a domain may move class without changing its id.

## Constraints

- The `## Domains` section is derived from every `docs/**/domain.md`. It is generated, and lint
  reports a stale table as an error.
- The engine never reads the router to find domains. The filesystem is the registry; the router
  exists for the human and the agent. That is why adding a domain requires editing nothing.

## Notes

There is exactly one Router, at `docs/ROUTER.md`.
